mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where l.due_date < #{today}) as overdue_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.due_date = #{today}) as today_cnt, count(*) filter (where l.due_date > #{today}) as soon_cnt from sal_order_line l where l.status = 'OPEN' and l.due_date <= #{until}

select o.order_no, l.line_no, c.cust_nm, i.item_cd, trim_scale(greatest(l.qty - l.shipped_qty, 0))::text as qty, i.unit_cd, l.due_date, o.order_date from sal_order_line l join sal_order o on o.order_id = l.order_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.status = 'OPEN' and l.due_date <= #{until} order by l.due_date, o.order_no, l.line_no limit #{limit}
